 Prayer:

Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o

 1997 covered under Award Notice of the 4th Respondent in
 Na.Ka.No.A2/347/2021 dated 03.02.2025, the benefits under the

 The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition
 Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and also based on the com
 representation of the Petitioners dated 20.06.2023, 01.07.2024 and
 03.03.2025 and dispose the same within the time frame that may be f
 by this Hon'ble Court.
For Petitioner(s) : Mr.S.Arokiamaniraj  For Respondent(s) : Mr.A.Selvendran for  Special Government   Mr.Abishek Murthy for R5  Standing Counsel for SIPCO  ORDER https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
By consent of learned counsel on both sides, this writ petition is taken up for final disposal at the admission stage itself.

2.The present writ petition is filed praying for a writ of mandamus, to direct the respondents to compute and pay to the petitioners for acquisition of their lands of 2 acres 10 cents in S.No.2/1 situated at Chellaperumpulimedu Revenue Village, Vembakkam Taluk, Tiruvannamalai District,
under the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purpose Act, 1997, covered under Award Notice of the 4th Respondent in Na.Ka.No.A2/347/2021 dated 03.02.2025, the benefits under the provisions of sections 26 to 30 and also Chapter V & I, II Schedule of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 Pannerselvam vs The Secretary To The Government on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97162829/
2 and also to dispose of the common representation of the petitioners dated 20.06.2023, 01.07.2024 and 03.03.2025.
3.After submitting for a brief while, learned Special Government Pleader would submit that the communication dated 03.02.2025 wherein it was stated that in respect of S.No.2/1, the persons claiming ownership shall obtain approval from the Revenue Divisional Officer and would https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 20/06/2025 03:41:37 pm ) thereafter, approach the Principal District Judge, Tiruvannamalai.

4.It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that they may be granted liberty to obtain approval from the Revenue Divisional Officer and thereafter, approach the Principal District Judge,
Tiruvannamalai, in support of its claim for computation and payment of compensation under the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 and under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
